scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-[1.1] font-bold

surfaces.glass_card: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.08] shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)] rounded-2xl

motion.scroll_reveal: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 40 }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }} viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }}

header.interactions: Hover color transition on links to primary_accent (#D4AF37), active state underline.

hero.layout: relative h-screen w-full flex flex-col justify-center overflow-hidden
hero.content: Cinematic text-reveal animation displaying 'Naga Law Chambers' and 'Land, Revenue & Property Law'.
hero.3d_element: React Three Fiber abstract 3D terrain grid symbolizing land/property law, reacting smoothly to mouse movement.
hero.visuals: Dark emerald gradient fading to midnight navy (#0A0A12) at the bottom to blend with the next section. Overlay with subtle noise texture.

advocate_profile.composition: Image: col-span-full md:col-span-5 | Bio/Text: col-span-full md:col-span-7
advocate_profile.image_treatment: MANDATORY: Use exact original asset '/advocate.jpg'. Wrap in a sleek glassmorphism bento card (glass_card) with micro-interactions on hover (slight scale up, border glow).
advocate_profile.text_treatment: Scroll-triggered staggered fade-in for Overline, Heading, Bio paragraphs, and Qualifications list.

practice_areas.composition: Bento grid layout (Mode A). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12.
practice_areas.style: glass_card style with frictionless transitions. Hover reveals a glowing #D4AF37 subtle radial gradient behind the card text.

contact.form_style: Floating input labels. Inputs have completely transparent backgrounds with a solid border-b (border-white/20), turning to #D4AF37 on focus. Terminal-style submit action (minimalist, tracking-[0.2em] uppercase gold text, sharp 1px border).

component_instructions.3d_scene: Use @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei. Implement a <Canvas> in the Hero section with a dark-themed wireframe terrain (representing land). Add floating particles. Ensure it gracefully degrades on mobile.
component_instructions.fonts: Import 'Cinzel' and 'Outfit' from next/font/google. Map Cinzel to font-serif or font-heading, and Outfit to font-sans.
component_instructions.testing: All interactive elements (nav links, buttons, form inputs) MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., 'data-testid="nav-home"', 'data-testid="contact-submit"').
component_instructions.libraries: Framer Motion for animations. Lucide-React for icons (sleek, minimal). clsx and tailwind-merge for class utility.
